blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Amateur Boxing Alliance of the Philippines (ABAP) is stepping up its grassroots boxing development program in Central Visayas, bringing together 71 coaches, trainers, and boxing officials for a one-day seminar aimed at improving their knowledge of international and Olympic-standard rules and regulations. Organized through the initiative of Cebuano boxing patron Lorenzo “Chao” Sy, the seminar was held at Hotel Fortuna in Cebu City, with ABAP president Marcus Manalo and secretary general Sebastian Ripoll leading the discussions. The activity focused on updating local boxing stakeholders on the latest rules and regulations while promoting athlete safety, fair matchups, […]...
